summary.en: An ancient weapon, a dead fleet, and a story that refuses to end.
summary.zh: 一件古代兵器、一支死去已久的舰队，和一个不肯结束的故事。

briefing.en: Go to Eventide in the Samarra system.
briefing.zh: 去 Samarra 星系内的 Eventide。
去 Samarra 星系内的 Eventide

texts.en:
Your comms officer notifies you of an incoming message for you, personally. You confirm your identity and access the file. The crest of House Rao of Eventide fills your display, evoking martial tradition, long-held wealth, and prestige.

"You are cordially invited to the grand seasonal ball at the spring estate of House Rao..."
texts.zh:
你的通讯军官通知你有个传给你的通讯消息，私人的。你进行身份识别后访问了文件。Eventide 的 Rao 家族纹章充斥了整个屏幕，象征着军人的传承，显赫的威望和持久的繁荣。

"本次的大型社交季舞会将在 Rao 家族的春色庄园举办，诚邀您的出席..."

options.en: Immediately take a shuttle to the Rao estate
options.zh: 搭乘穿梭机前往 Rao 家族的庄园

options.en: Take care of other business first
Delete the invitation

texts.en: As you don your best apparel as a shuttle is prepared, and you consider your primary goal, which is to...
texts.zh: 在穿梭机整备的空档里，你换上了最好的正装，开始考虑起此行的目的。你应该...

options.en: Make useful connections in the Hegemony officer corps
options.zh: 在 霸主 军官中建立有用的人脉关系

options.en: It's a party! Just have a good time
Find a way to disgrace Caspian Sang
options.zh: 设法让 Caspian Sang 颜面扫地

options.en: Keep an open mind and watch for opportunities

texts.en:
Your shuttle follows a course to the surface authorized by the datakey attached to your invitation to the grand spring ball of Eventide.

You watch as the sprawling spires and annexes of House Rao's spring manor rise on the horizon from a fertile, protected valley. The battlements of vast storm clouds stream beyond distant ridgelines by some quirk of geography which channels airflow around this eye of calm.
texts.zh:
由邀请函附带的数据密钥授权，你的穿梭机向星球表面飞去，将你带向 Eventide 的盛大春季舞会。

向着由群山庇护的肥沃谷地望去，你看到 Rao 家族春色庄园里绵延不绝的高楼尖顶和别馆一起从地平线上展露出来。犹如城垛般高耸的暴风云墙在远方的山脊之外肆意奔流，但此处独特的地貌引导着气流，产生了一处平静的风眼。

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
Your shuttle descends through shafts of light reflected from orbital mirrors. You observe that on this occasion the Raos have arranged for artful placement of the mirrors to provide dramatic mirrorsets in several vistas viewable from the manor.

Upon landing you are intercepted and greeted by a human servitor in a crimson and silver house uniform. Your pilots and bodyguards, meanwhile, are directed toward a utilitarian waiting area stocked with ample refreshment.
texts.zh:
穿梭机缓缓下降，穿过轨道恒星镜投下的光束。你注意到 Rao 家族为了这次盛会精妙地布置了镜面的位置，用反射镜群给庄园平添了不少光彩夺目的靓丽景观。

着陆之后，身披赤银双色家族制服的真人侍从用热情的问候把你截了下来。与此同时，你的驾驶员和保镖则被领到了堆满了各种餐点的随行人员休息区。

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
You are led to a bulbous lift with no visible control interface. As soon as the doors close, it begins a smooth ascent toward the spires of the manor while the servitor makes soothing inquiries about your trip.

There is no perceptible change in subjective gravity as the lift accelerates upward; the agrav plates here are very finely tuned indeed.
texts.zh:
你被请进了一个看不到控制面板的球状电梯中。门一关上，它就开始平稳地朝着庄园的塔顶上升，同时侍者柔声询问你的旅途是否顺利。

当电梯加速上升时，主观重力没有明显的变化，看来这里的反重力装置经过了精密的调整。

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
The servitor whisks you past soaring windows blazing with the light of mirrorset to a grand set of doors. They signal for you to wait for just a moment, following some opaque choreography of the event. Within a minute, it is your time.

The grand doors swing open with the silent gravity of the celestial spheres, sweeping you into the ballroom of House Rao.
texts.zh:
侍者领着你走过一系列被恒星镜组照射得光彩夺目的高耸窗扉，来到一排宏伟的门前。他们示意你稍等片刻，以便遵守一些活动编排的潜规则。最多还有一分钟，就到你登场的时候了。

在天球仪无声的引力之下，宏伟的大门敞开，让你隆重地走入了 Rao 家族的舞会厅。

options.en: Enter the ballroom

texts.en:
"$playerName," your name rings through the great hall. A brief pause, then "Commissioned auxiliary officer of the Hegemony Navy."

A few heads turn to take you in. There, a dismissive brow raise, there a too-quick flick of the eyes. The attendees seem little bothered to match your name to a face.

Resplendent brass of the Hegemony Navy dominate the crowd, though there are a smattering from the Legion as well as the various ministries spun off from the naval hierarchy.
texts.zh:
"$playerName，" 你的名字响彻大厅，短暂的停顿后，那声音继续道，"霸主 海军的辅助军军官。"

有几个人转过头来看你。有人轻蔑地抬了抬眉毛，有人只是随便瞟了你一眼。与会者似乎不太愿意浪费精力去把你的脸和名字匹配起来。

人群中，最显眼的便是来自 霸主 海军的那些衣着华丽的高级军官，此外也有少数来自军团的，以及一些来自从海军中分离出来的部门的人。

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
Less overt but as numerous are civilians in suit, dress, and robe that generally but not as a rule evoke the martial character of Hegemony rule. Despite the political climate, you even recognize the characteristic fashions of several other major factions, religions, and independent megacorporations; diplomats, business execs, holo-actors, priests, and even a cluster bearing the garb of tenured Galatia Academy academicians.

Now you can get to doing what you came here for.
texts.zh:
霸主 治下的民众普遍尚武，但并不绝对。因此虽然并不显眼，但这里也有为数不少的平民穿着西装，礼服和法衣。尽管政治基调不同，你还是认出了其他几个主要势力、宗教团体和独立巨型企业的服饰风格，外交官，企业高管，全息电影演员，祭司，甚至还有一群穿着 Galatia 学院终身院士服的人。

现在你可以做你打算做的事了。

options.en: Introduce yourself to someone important
Get the party started! Step 1- find a drink
options.zh: 让派对开始吧！第一步，来杯酒

options.en: Scan the crowd for the insufferable Caspian Sang
options.zh: 在人群中找找烦人的 Caspian Sang

options.en: Get a feel for the room before taking any action
options.zh: 在行动前先审视一下屋子里的人物们

texts.en:
Your eyes roam over the crowd, looking for the push and pull of influence. You note the figures of vast power moving through the space, attracting satellites and disturbing orbits. There, a space marshall of the reserve fleet; there, the prime executor of Eventide's planetary government. There, the chief operations officer of a major military contractor.

"$PlayerSirOrMadam." A human servitor interrupts your train of thought, offering a tray filled with delicate glasses of something effervescent.
texts.zh:
你的目光在人群中游荡，找寻着各种影响力相互制衡的迹象。犹如在宇宙中肆意驰骋一般，各种权豪势要云集的光景呈现了你眼前，呈众星捧月之态，携移星换斗之势。这边是一位后备舰队的太空元帅，那里则是 Eventide 行星政府的首席执行长。而旁边这位又是一家大型军事承包商的首席运营官。

"$PlayerSirOrMadam。" 一位服务员出现在了你身边，向你呈上了排满精致酒杯的托盘，杯子里面装着一些冒泡的饮料。

options.en: Take a glass
Wave them away

texts.en: You hear a familiar and not entirely welcome voice pierce the murmur of conversation and soft music.
texts.zh: 一个你很熟悉但令人不爽的声音和周围交谈的低语和轻柔的音乐一起传了过来。

texts.en:
"Why captain," Caspian Sang oozes up to you. His uniform is as newly pressed and his smile as insincere as at your last meeting. "I see you've already found your commission payment," he indicates your untouched beverage, "The bounty of our fine hosts' noblesse oblige so soon plundered, eh."

You smell the spirits on his breath as he continues to speak. "But I give you too little credit. You serve the Hegemony, do you not? Give a little show of it now and pass me the top-up, will you?"

Over Caspian's shoulder you see his gang of minions tittering.
texts.zh:
"怎么了，舰长，" Caspian Sang 慢悠悠地开口了。尽管身上的制服是新熨烫过的，他的笑容却依旧和上次一样虚伪，"看来你已经搞到你的佣金了，" 他指着你那没动过的饮料，"东道主尽地主之谊，风度翩翩地慷慨施恩，可没想到这么快就被你这种人给糟蹋了。"

当他继续说下去时，你闻到了一身酒气。"但我还是让你赚得太少了点。你说你为 霸主 效忠，不是吗？现在是你立功的好机会，帮我加满这杯酒，好吗？"

目光越过 Caspian 的肩头，你看到他那群跟屁虫在窃笑。

options.en: I didn't come here to spar with you, Sang.
Pardon me, I was about to speak with someone else.
options.zh: 对不起，我正要去和别人谈谈。

options.en: Cool your flux ace, I'm just trying to enjoy a drink.
options.zh: 冷静点，我只是想好好喝一杯。

options.en: Do you always call the auxiliaries to get anything done, lieutenant?
options.zh: 你总是把责任推给辅助军吗，上尉？

options.en: Sang, have I offended you somehow?
Throw the drink in his face
Punch his stupid face

texts.en:
"Yes, captain, you have." The cruel spark in Caspian's eye grows. "By showing up. It was a test, you see, and you failed. You don't know your place. Not yet."

He licks his lips. This is just the opening salvo.
texts.zh:
"不，舰长，你就是。" Caspian 的眼中闪过无情的光芒，"因为你真的来了。瞧，这是一场测试，而你没有合格。你没有好好掂量过自己的地位，至少至今还没有。"

他舔了舔嘴唇。看来刚才那番话还只是个开场白而已。

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
A woman in the uniform of a Hegemony commander appears, already looking at Sang with suspicion.

"Lieutenant Sang, was it?" Without shifting her focus she tosses a cocktail napkin at him. "I see you've been welcoming a new arrival to my family's celebration."

As Sang fails to catch the napkin you can almost see his bully's instincts grappling with the new social dynamic in play.

She nods politely to you. "Commander Neriene Rao. And if I recall correctly, you are Captain $playerName?"
texts.zh:
这时，一名身穿 霸主 海军中校制服的女性露面了，她正用怀疑的目光看着 Sang。

"Sang 上尉，对吧？"依然紧盯着对方，她将一张酒巾抛向了 Sang。"我看到你在欢迎来参加我们家庆祝活动的新来宾。"

Sang 没能接住酒巾，你能看出这差点让他那恃强凌弱的本性在新的事态下再次发作。

女子礼貌地向你点头致意。"Neriene Rao 中校。如果我没记错的话，你就是 $playerName 舰长？"

texts.en:
A woman in the uniform of a Hegemony commander appears, taking the center of attention, and speaks with a voice lifted to the crowd of onlookers.

"Lieutenant Sang, was it? I see you've been welcoming a new arrival to my family's celebration with your usual charm."

A polite wave of laughter from the onlookers breaks the tension. They start to turn back to their conversations. You can see Caspian's face turning red as his bully's instincts grapple with the new social dynamic.

She nods politely to you. "Commander Neriene Rao. If I recall correctly, you are... captain $playerName?"
texts.zh:
这时，一名身穿 霸主 海军中校制服的女性出现了，并且很快引起了他人的注意，她提高了音量以便让旁观者都能听清楚。

"是 Sang 上尉，对吧？我看到你又用你的老把戏来欢迎参加我们家庆祝活动的新来宾了。"

旁观者礼貌地笑了笑，打破了紧张的气氛，并回到了他们原本的谈话中。你看到 Caspian 的脸变得通红，正在压制他恃强凌弱本性以跟上场上事态的变化。

女子礼貌地向你点头致意。" Neriene Rao 中校。如果我没记错的话，你是... $playerName 舰长？"

"Lieutenant Sang, was it?" she says, projecting her voice. "I see you've been welcoming a new arrival to my family's celebration."

You can almost see his bully's instincts grappling with the new social dynamic in play.

She nods politely to you. "Commander Neriene Rao. If I recall correctly, you are... captain $playerName?"

这时，一名身穿 霸主 海军中校制服的女性出现了，她正用鄙夷的目光看着 Sang。

"是 Sang 上尉，对吧？"她开口道，"我看到你已经欢迎了来参加我们家的庆祝活动的新来宾。"

texts.en:
Neriene faces you, cutting Caspian out of the conversation.

You watch in your peripheral vision as he realizes what's been done. He scuttles back toward his minions. The joking is over. They look at you now with sneering hostility.
texts.zh:
Neriene 看向了你，把 Caspian 排除在了你们的对话外。

你通过余光注意到，Sang 意识到如今发生了什么。他急忙跑回自己的跟屁虫们之中。闹剧结束了。他们现在带着轻蔑和敌意看着你。

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
"That boy," she says, "is a weak-willed fool who believes that he must tear down others to build up himself."

She looks you over, "And it would seem that he chose a poor target this time around. And even had he not, I expect someone would have to shoot down his little game before he made much more of a scene."

She sighs, "There's the family name to think of, after all."
texts.zh:
"那小子，" 她说道，"只是个没主见的蠢货，跟风觉得必须践踏别人才能成就自己。"

她打量着你，"看来他这次挑了个不该惹的目标。不过即便不是这样，我也只能指望能来个人在他把事情闹大之前拆了他的小把戏。"

她叹了口气，"毕竟，还得考虑家族的名声呢。"

texts.en: "Caspian Sang is a fool and he deserved that," she says with a hint of smile. "There are times I wish I'd done the same. But," Neriene looks around, "There's the family name to think of."
texts.zh: " Caspian Sang 就是个蠢货，他自找的，" 她带着一丝微笑说道，"好几次我都想这么做。但是，" Neriene 环顾四周，"总还得顾及到家族的名声呢。"

texts.en:
"Caspian Sang is a fool and he deserved that," she says with a frown, "But striking an officer won't endear you to the others. It's also technically illegal, but if you follow my lead nothing should come of it. Sang is not the sort to endure well the shame of filing such a report."

"Besides," she says, looking around, "It might offend the family."
texts.zh:
"Caspian Sang 是个蠢货，那是他自找的，" 她皱着眉头，"但殴打军官可不讨喜。严格来说，这也是违法的。但如果你听我的，就没人会追究。Sang 应该拉不下脸来亲自举报你，毕竟那只会自取其辱。"

"更何况，" 她边说边环顾四周，"那可能冒犯到某个家族。"

options.en: House Rao. As in, the owners of this estate.
options.zh: Rao 家族，也就是这庄园的主人。

texts.en:
"Yes. Yes, we are. Absurd, isn't it?" She looks a little sheepish, "I mean, it's home. But this, this palace? In the face of everything going on out there?"

She looks up, past the mirrorset illuminating the grand windows of the ballroom. "We're supposed to be rebuilding the Domain, aren't we?"

"Maybe we are," she adds darkly.
texts.zh:
"对，对，是我们的。满目荒唐，不是吗？" 她看起来并不以此为荣，"我的意思是，这是我的家没错。但这样一座富丽堂皇的宫殿？展现在外面风雨飘摇的世界面前？"

她抬起头，目光看向了把气派的舞厅窗户点缀得流光溢彩的恒星镜组。"我们不是应该去重建 人之领 吗？"

"搞不好这就是。" 她阴沉地小声嘟囔。

options.en: What do you mean by that?
Does Admiral Orcus Rao agree with you?
options.zh: Orcus Rao 将军同意你的观点吗？

texts.en:
As Neriene begins to reply, you find the crowds in the ballroom withdrawing toward the sides of the room. During your exchange with Sang, you must have missed some announcement because the live band at the end of the great hall is beginning to play a waltz.

Dancers partner up from the edge of the floor. You catch a glimpse of Sang and his flunkies keeping an eye on you, still held off by the force of Neriene's presence.

You look at her for some kind of cue. She looks at you expectantly.
texts.zh:
正当 Neriene 要开口答话时，你注意到舞厅里的人群都向房间的四周退去。看来一定是你在和 Sang 交锋的时错过了什么通知，因为这时大厅尽头的乐队开始演奏起了华尔兹。

场边的舞者们开始争相结伴。在其中你碰巧瞥见 Sang 和他的跟屁虫们还正盯着你，却因为 Neriene 在场而不敢上前。

你用眼神向她寻求提示，但她却用期许的目光回应了你。

options.en: Shall we?
Say nothing
I don't dance.
Um. Where can a space captain get a fresh drink around here?
options.zh: 呃，那么太空舰长该去哪找饮料喝呢？

options.en: Try very hard to initiate a Transverse Jump
options.zh: 竭尽全力尝试手搓一次横轴跳跃

texts.en: Neriene of House Rao nods and takes your hand. You find yourself pulled toward the center of the dance floor with the inevitability of a singularity's gravity well.
texts.zh: 这位 Rao 家的 Neriene 大小姐点了点头，握起了你的手。你发现自己立即就被拉入了舞池的正中央，仿佛有个无法逃离的奇点重力井在那儿一样。

options.en: Continue

texts.en: You are slow to follow at first, not being accustomed to ballroom dancing with the elite of Eventide, but Neriene is patient and accommodating, providing instructions on the local customs in a low voice. She is, you suspect, a commander able to embolden green crews toward good performance under pressure.
texts.zh: 起初你有些跟不上节奏，还没习惯 Eventide 的精英们跳的这种交谊舞。但 Neriene 随和且耐心，低声指导你跟上当地的习俗舞步。你感觉她是一个能够激励新手船员在高压之下高效完成任务的指挥官。

texts.en: She is quick to follow, though you suspect not accustomed to that role. Nor is ballroom dancing with the Hegemony elite of Eventide much in your wheelhouse, but Neriene provides a few suggestions pursuant to the local customs in a low voice. She is, you suspect, a commander able to embolden green crews toward good performance under pressure.
texts.zh: 她迅速跟上了节奏，尽管你怀疑她并不习惯成为舞伴。但你与 Eventide 霸主精英共跳交谊舞的技术也没好到能让你随心乘风转舵。察觉到这一点后，Neriene 低声指导了你几句，让你跟上当地的传统舞步。你感到她是个能够激励新手船员在高压环境下高效完成任务的指挥官。

texts.en: Before long, you find yourselves caught up in the rhythm of the movements and for a short moment you manage to forget about petty bullies and factional politics.
texts.zh: 很快，你就发现自己跟上了当下舞步的节奏，暂时把周围无聊的欺压和派系的政见全都给抛到了脑后。

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
The next song begins, and inertia takes you.

"So," says Neriene over your shoulder. "You know who I am, why I'm here." A step, a turn.

"Why are you here, captain? I know it's not for Caspian Sang."
texts.zh:
下一支曲开始，你们顺势继续。

"那么，" Neriene 的声音从你肩后传来，"你知道我是谁，我为什么在这里。" 顺着舞步，她转到了你的面前。

"你又是为什么来，舰长？我知道不是为了 Caspian Sang。"

options.en: I was hoping to talk with someone important.
options.zh: 我想和些重要人物谈谈。

options.en: I just can't turn down an invitation to a good party.
options.zh: 我没法拒绝这样一个美妙宴会的邀请。

options.en: It really was to prove Sang wrong, somehow.
options.zh: 不晓得怎么的，我之前就是想来证明 Sang 惹错人了。

options.en: Hard to say. It felt like I ought to be here.
options.zh: 很难说，我就觉得我该来这里。

options.en: For you, of course.

texts.en: "Then I must apologize for disappointing you," she says with a wry smile.
texts.zh: "那很抱歉让你失望了，" 她苦笑着说。

options.en: Continue

texts.en: You see Neriene's eyes focus on something behind you, and her expression goes hard as she pulls away from you.
texts.zh: 你注意到 Neriene 似乎在看着你身后的什么，随即她脸色一沉，从你身边抽身退开。

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
"Oh $playerName!"

You know that nasal tone all too well, now, and slowly turn to see Caspian Sang and his entourage behind a thick-necked lieutenant.
texts.zh:
"喔，$playerName！"

你现在对他的声音已经再熟悉不过了，你慢慢地转过身去，看见 Caspian Sang 和他的跟班们正站在一个粗脖子的上尉后面。

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
The new lieutenant ignores Sang entirely. "Neriene," he says. "What's this then, slumming with frontier trash?"

"Magnus Cardona," she whispers to you, "A real piece of-"
texts.zh:
新来的上尉完全无视了 Sang。"Neriene，" 他说道，"你在做什么，和边缘星区来的垃圾瞎混在一起？"

"Magnus Cardona，" 她朝你耳语，"这人就是一坨..."

texts.en:
Sang calls out, "Let the auxiliary-captain speak!"

Cardona shoots Sang a look that shuts him up, then turns his dead-eyed stare to you. "I'm to understand that this frontier barbarian impugned the honor of a Hegemony officer tonight."

The dance has stopped, the band finally having got the hint. All eyes are on you.
texts.zh:
Sang 大声道，"让这个辅助军舰长自己说！"

Cardona 瞪了 Sang 一眼让他闭嘴，然后他死死地盯住了你。"我已经充分了解到，今晚一有个边缘星区来的野蛮人践踏了一位 霸主 军官的荣誉。"

舞曲停了下来，看来乐队已经看到了这边的情况。所有人的目光都集中在了你的身上。

texts.en:
Cardona calls out, "I'm to understand that this frontier barbarian assaulted the honor of a Hegemony officer tonight."

The dance has stopped, the band finally having got the hint. All eyes are on you.
texts.zh:
Cardona 喊到，"我已经充分了解到，今晚有个边缘星区来的野蛮人践踏了一位 霸主 军官的荣誉。"

舞曲停了下来，看来乐队已经看到了这边的情况。所有人的目光都集中在了你的身上。

options.en: No, Caspian managed that all on his own.
options.zh: 不，那是 Caspian 自导自演的。

options.en: Who, me?
Why don't we all have a drink and calm down.
options.zh: 不如一起喝一杯，然后冷静下来谈谈？

options.en: Caspian has such a punchable face, it couldn't be helped.
options.zh: 谁叫 Caspian 长得那么欠扁，让我没忍住。

options.en: Who, me?
Why don't we all have a drink and calm down.
options.zh: 不如喝一杯，然后冷静下来谈谈？

texts.en:
"He's irrelevant. You attacked the uniform, and for that," Cardona loosens his sword, "I challenge you to honorable combat."

Sang grins from behind him, relishing the moment.
texts.zh:
"他本人无关紧要，你攻击的是这一身制服，而为此，" Cardona 解下了佩剑，"我要向你发起光荣的决斗。"

Sang 在他身后咧嘴笑着，似乎很享受这一刻。

options.en: I accept.
Too scared to fight me yourself, Caspian?
Is this legal?
I prefer space combat.
No, thank you.

texts.en: Cardona nods. "Prepare yourself."
texts.zh: Cardona 点了点头，"做好准备。"

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
Your acceptance washes across the crowd, waking them as if from a stupor. Their murmuring fills the hall. Cardona, Sang, and the rest gather and begin walking toward a tall set of doors at one end of the ballroom. Others join them, mostly officers, mostly young men.

"Grandmother!" Neriene calls out; you follow her pleading look to a stately woman overseeing the entire affair. "Put a stop to this, there's no need for bloodshed on this night."
texts.zh:
你的决定震惊了人群，把他们从恍惚中唤醒。他们的窃窃私语充满了大厅。Cardona，Sang 和剩下的人聚到了一起，开始走向舞厅一端一扇高大的门。其他人也加入了他们，大部分是军官和年轻人。

"祖母！" Neriene 喊道；你顺着她那恳求的眼神，发现一位端庄的女士在看着这一切。"叫停吧，今晚没必要发生流血事件。"

options.en: Continue

texts.en: You recognize Augusta Rao from the news holos. Her head pitches almost imperceptibly - a denial - before she turns her back and moves away, pulling in her wake a retinue of ministers and aristocrats.
texts.zh: 你在全息新闻里见到过这个人，Augusta Rao。她用旁人难以察觉的幅度抬了一下脸表示拒绝，然后就转过身，在一群随行官员和贵族的陪同下离开了。

options.en: Continue
Continue

texts.en:
On a bench before you lies a dueling kit: hardened boots, gloves, and helmet. A neatly folded jumpsuit of material smart enough to allow only what it judges to be non-lethal jabs and cuts comes with a suite of embedded medical sensors to automatically perform first-aid upon injury. "Deaths are very rare," a minor aristocrat assures you as he hands a scabbard to Neriene Rao.

She waves him back toward the gawkers with an annoyed look. There are fewer gathered around you, and fewer uniforms, than those egging on Cardona and Sang.

"This is stupid," she says, drawing the sword a handswidth and examining the edge. "You don't have to go through with it."
texts.zh:
你面前的长台面上摆着一整套的决斗装备：坚固的靴子、手套和头盔，还有一套连身衣整齐地叠放在一旁。连身衣由智能材料构成，只允许被认定为非致命的刺击和劈砍穿过它。同时它还带有一套嵌入式医疗设备，可以在受伤时自动执行急救。"几乎没人在决斗时死去，" 一位低阶贵族向你保证道，同时他把一支没出鞘的剑递给了 Neriene Rao。

她挥手把这位低阶贵族赶回了看客之中，脸上止不住地流露出懊恼的神情。相对于 Cardona 和 Sang 那边，你这边围上来的人很少，而其中穿制服的家伙就更少了。

"这太蠢了，" 她说着，把剑抽出一掌宽，仔细检查起剑刃来。"你没必要这么做。"

texts.en: Neriene pauses a moment, then says "Before you go through with this, would you like to take a few practice swings to warm up?"
texts.zh: Neriene 停顿了一阵，然后开口道，"在开始之前，要不要先挥几下试试？"

options.en: I'm ready to fight.
I won't have them think me a coward.
options.zh: 我不会让他们把我当成懦夫的。

options.en: What do you mean by people like Cardona?
options.zh: 你说' Cardona 那样的人'是什么意思？

options.en: Charming traditions you have here.
options.zh: 你们这儿的传统还真迷人。

options.en: Just take the sword
I have studied the blade. (easier fight)
options.zh: 我略懂击剑。 (战斗难度降低)

options.en: Take a few practice swings (sword tutorial)
You're right, this is stupid. I'm leaving.
options.zh: 你说得对，这太蠢了，我要走了。

texts.en:
"If you're sure," she says.

As you begin to step away, she adds "And... give him hell!"
texts.zh:
"如果你确定的话。" 她说道。

当你迈步离开时，她补了一句，"顺便...给他点颜色看看！"

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
Dressed in dueling gear and wielding Neriene's sword, you are led to one end of a columned loggia that seems to hang over the valley below.

Magnus Cardona steps forward, and the crowds withdraw.
texts.zh:
披挂好决斗装备之后，你握起 Neriene 的剑，跟着领路人走到了一条长廊的尽头。长廊被高耸的立柱支起，看起来仿佛是悬在峡谷之上。

Magnus Cardona 踏步上前，人群向后退去。

options.en: Fight

texts.en: Neriene sighs, "It doesn't matter what those children think. I just can't believe grandmother is allowing this to go on. Emboldening people like Cardona is going to cause trouble."
texts.zh: Neriene 叹了口气，"没必要和那些孩子较真。我只是不敢相信，祖母居然会允许这件事发生。纵容 Cardona 那样的人只会带来麻烦。"

texts.en:
"It's, um. Complicated. Political." She doesn't like to talk about it, you think.

"There are those in the Hegemony that think they - we, I mean; those whose families came from the officers of the Fourteenth Battlegroup - that we're somehow better than everyone else. It's ridiculous."
texts.zh:
"这，嗯。很复杂，政治因素。" 看起来她不太愿意谈这个。

"霸主 中有些人是 第十四战斗群 的后裔，他们认为他们...不，应该说是我们，比其他任何人都强。但这太荒谬了。"

texts.en:
"One that has no place in a civilized society," she says. "But I suppose we aren't quite that, are we."

She looks toward one of the mirrorsets.
texts.zh:
"那东西在文明社会里根本没有用武之地。但看来我们还没文明到那个程度，不是吗？"

她这么说到，目光看向其中一套恒星镜组。

texts.en:
She hands you the scabbard with the sword, "This was given to me by my father."

"But it doesn't have any sentimental value." She gives you a quick look, "I never cared for swordplay."
texts.zh:
她把剑连鞘一起递给了你，"这是我父亲给我的。"

"但这没什么情感价值在里边，" 她瞥了一眼你的表情，"我不怎么喜欢剑术。"

texts.en:
Neriene looks doubtful as she hands you the scabbard.

You draw the blade in a single movement and demonstrate a lunge or two. The crowd gathering around you cheers and calls boasts toward the other end of the loggia.

"Those idiots might have made a bigger mistake than I thought," she admits with an impressed look.
texts.zh:
Neriene 把剑递你的时候看起来还有些将信将疑。

你干脆利落地拔剑出鞘，比划了个凌厉的弓步直刺，快得没法看清是出手了一次还是两次。聚在你周围的人群欢呼雀跃起来，还向走廊另一端发出吹嘘的声音。

"那些白痴犯了比我想象中更大的错误。" 她看起来承认了你有些本事。

texts.en: "Good," she says, and drops the scabbard onto the pile of dueling kit.
texts.zh: "很好，" 她说着，把剑扔到了那堆决斗用具里。

texts.en: The crowd jeers. Neriene gives the closest hecklers a killing look; they quickly discover that they were less enthusiastic about this duel than they had thought. Her status as a member of House Rao and host of the ball does not shield you from general disdain, however, and she quickly leads you through a discreet servants' access lift and back to your shuttle's pad.
texts.zh: 人群哄笑起来。随着 Neriene 向旁边咧嘴大笑的人投去了一个杀气腾腾的眼神，他们很快就识趣地发现了自己对这场决斗的热情没有想象中那么高。虽然身为 Rao 家的一员和舞会主持人，她并不能替你挡下所有的蔑视，但尽其所能地，她指引你进入了一个不起眼的侍者专用电梯，让你回到了你穿梭机的停泊处。

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
The staff is efficient; your entourage is summoned without requiring your intervention, though they seem to have been interrupted in the middle of a meal, wiping hands and one guard popping an anti-inebriant.

Shuttle prepped, Neriene sees you off from the launch pad.

"Well," she says uncomfortably, "I apologize for... for everything. We're not all clannish brutes."
texts.zh:
这里的员工效率很高；不需要你的提醒，他们就招来了你的随从。不过他们应该是饭才吃到一半的时候被叫出来的，全都还在擦着手。有个保镖还在你面前磕了一片醒酒药。

穿梭机已经准备就绪，Neriene 在发射台送别你。

"总之，" 她听上去一点都高兴不起来，"我为... 这一切向你道歉。我们并不都是排外的野蛮人。"

options.en: I won't hold their actions against you.
options.zh: 我不会因为他们的行为指责你。

options.en: I've survived worse. It's no hull breach, for instance.
options.zh: 我见过更糟的。这次又不是船上破了个洞，打个比方。

options.en: I enjoyed the dance. We should do it again.
options.zh: 至少我觉得跳舞挺有趣的，有机会我们该再试试。

options.en: Don't. They just showed me what you really are.
options.zh: 别装了，他们只不过是让我看到了你们的真面目而已。

texts.en:
She nods, accepting your words, her face still grim.

"Until a better time, captain."

She turns away before you can reply, heading toward the manor complex.
texts.zh: 她点点头，接受了你的话，但脸色依旧不好看。"再择良日吧，舰长。" 你还没来得及回答，她就转身朝庄园走了回去。

options.en: Leave

texts.en: Your shuttle rejoins your $shipOrFleet above $entityName.
texts.zh: 你的穿梭机返回了 $entityName 上方的$shipOrFleet中。

texts.en:
"No, I suppose not," she says, the start of a smile on her face.

"Until a better time, captain," she says then turns away before you can reply, heading toward the manor complex.
texts.zh: "嗯，确实。" 她说，脸上笑容重现，"再择良日吧，舰长。"你还没来得及回答，她就转身朝庄园建筑群走了回去。

options.en: Leave

texts.en:
"I'd like that," she says, the start of a smile on her face.

She looks like she is about to say more, but instead nods quickly and turns away before you can reply, heading toward the manor complex.
texts.zh: "我也这么想，" 她说，脸上笑容重现。她看起来还想说什么，但取而代之地，她点了点头后转身朝庄园建筑群走了回去 —— 在你能做出答复之前。

options.en: Leave

texts.en: She looks hurt, opens her mouth to speak, then closes it and quickly turns away, heading toward the manor complex.
texts.zh: 她看起来受到了不小的打击，张开嘴想说些什么，但很快一言不发地闭上嘴，转身朝庄园建筑群走了回去。

options.en: Leave

texts.en: You catch a glimpse of Sang's panic before Cardona steps forward, putting himself between you and Sang. "It is I who have challenged you. Answer me now!"
texts.zh: 你注意到 Sang 慌了起来，但这时 Cardona 走上前挡在了你们之间，"挑战你的是我，现在做出答复！"

texts.en: "I'm afraid so," Neriene says. "Technically."
texts.zh: "恐怕，" Neriene 说，"的确是合法的。"

texts.en:
"On Eventide we have the courage to fight face to face," Cardona says.

"Now answer my challenge!"
texts.zh:
"在 Eventide 我们有面对面对决的勇气，" Cardona 说。

"现在做出你的答复！"

texts.en:
"Then you prove that you don't belong here among us," Cardona sneers.

"You've the thin frontier blood of thieves and failures. Crawl away now, barbarian, and be thankful the Hegemony came to save your kind when you proved unable to rule yourself."
texts.zh:
"那就证明你不配站在这里。" Cardona 冷笑道。

"你这生自边缘星区的贱骨头注定了你就是个坑蒙拐骗的废物。现在滚吧，没文化的，等到你们都管不好自己的时候，再来感谢去拯救你们的 霸主 吧。"

options.en: On second thought, I accept.
options.zh: 我又考虑了一下，还是接受吧。

options.en: Your crude tradition proves nothing. Good-bye.
options.zh: 你那粗俗的传统什么也证明不了，再见。

options.en: Barbarian? You're the one threatening guests with oversized cutlery.
options.zh: 野蛮人？现在用超大号餐具威胁客人的可是你啊。

options.en: Leave

texts.en: Neriene follows you. "Good," she says to you under her breath.
texts.zh: Neriene 跟上了你。"不错。" 她压低声音对你说道。

texts.en:
This prompts a few snickers and a guffaw from the crowd. Cardona looks furiously to each side, then straight at you.

"Answer my challenge," he shouts, "And do it now!"
texts.zh:
这恰到好处的反讽让周围的人群里传来了零星忍俊不禁的笑声。Cardona 怒不可遏地朝两边看了看，然后又直直瞪向了你。

"回应我的挑战，" 他喊道，"现在就做出回应！"

options.en: On second thought, I accept.
options.zh: 我又考虑了一下，还是接受吧。

options.en: Your crude tradition proves nothing. Good-bye.
options.zh: 你那粗俗的传统什么也证明不了，再见。

options.en: Just leave

texts.en:
"You. $playerName. You attacked the uniform, and for that," Cardona loosens his sword, "I challenge you to honorable combat."

Sang grins from behind him, relishing this moment.
texts.zh:
"你，$playerName，你攻击了这一身制服，而为此，" Cardona 解下了佩剑，"我要向你发起光荣的决斗。"

Sang 在他身后咧嘴笑着，似乎很享受这一刻。

texts.en: "Good," she says with a smile, "Because I'm finally starting to enjoy myself."
texts.zh: "不错，" 她笑着说，"因为我也终于开始感受到乐趣了。"

options.en: Continue

texts.en: She frowns, "Though I agree with the sentiment, it's not him you need to worry about."
texts.zh: 她皱起眉头，"我理解你这种情绪，但你需要在意的不是他。"

options.en: Continue

texts.en: "Then it's fate," she says with a wry smile, "Somehow I didn't take you for a romantic."
texts.zh: "那就是命运了，" 她露出了个古怪的笑容，"我没料到你是个浪漫的人。"

options.en: Continue

texts.en: "A barefaced lie," she says with a smile, "But it's a nice thought."
texts.zh: "这谎说得还真是没羞没臊的。" 她笑着说，"不过还挺中听的。"

options.en: Continue

texts.en: Neriene of House Rao takes your hand and pulls you toward the center of the dance floor with the inevitability of a singularity's gravity well.
texts.zh: 这位 Rao 家的 Neriene 大小姐抓起你的手，把你拉入了舞池的正中央，仿佛有个无法逃离的奇点重力井在那儿一样。

options.en: Continue

texts.en: Neriene of House Rao gives you a skeptical look. "Are you at least willing to try?"
texts.zh: 这位 Rao 家的 Neriene 大小姐一脸狐疑地盯着你。"你至少愿意试一试吧？"

options.en: Yes.
No. I'm going to leave now.

texts.en: "Then I'll show you," she says, taking your hand. You find yourself pulled toward the center of the dance floor with the inevitability of a singularity's gravity well.
texts.zh: "那我来教你。" 她这么说着，拉起了你的手。你发现自己立即就被拉入了舞池的正中央，仿佛有个无法逃离的奇点重力井在那儿一样。

options.en: Continue

texts.en: You turn and find your way toward the edge of the room, leaving a bemused Neriene of House Rao on the dance floor.
texts.zh: 你转身朝房间的边缘走去，将 Rao 家的 Neriene 大小姐一脸茫然地留在舞池里。

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
Jeers and laughter come from the direction of Sang's minions, but they're ignored easily enough as you turn your back on the ballroom.

You have no doubt that you'll be the butt of their jokes all night.

A quick inquiry with one of the uniformed staff allows you access to a discreet servants' access lift and back to your shuttle's pad with a minimum of fuss.
texts.zh:
嘲笑声从 Sang 的跟屁虫们那边传了过来，但在你转身离开舞厅时，忽视它们并不难。

你肯定成为了他们一整晚的笑柄。

简短地询问身着制服的工作人员后，你进入了不起眼的侍者用电梯，返回了你的穿梭机停机坪，没遇到什么麻烦。

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
The staff is efficient; your entourage is summoned without requiring your intervention, though they seem to have been interrupted in the middle of a meal, wiping hands and one guard popping an anti-inebriant.

Your shuttle is prepped and ready to leave.
texts.zh:
这里的员工效率很高；不需要你的提醒，他们就招来了你的随从。不过他们应该是饭才吃到一半的时候被叫出来的，全都还在擦着手。有个保镖还在你面前磕了一片醒酒药。

你的穿梭机已经准备就绪，可以出发了。

options.en: Board and order return to orbit

texts.en: Your shuttle rejoins your $shipOrFleet above $entityName.
texts.zh: 你的穿梭机返回了 $entityName 上方的$shipOrFleet中。

texts.en:
Neriene of House Rao gives you a skeptical look. "There's one in your hand. But you're going to have to put it down if we're going to dance."

She snaps her fingers and instantly a servitor appears with a tray to take your drink.
texts.zh:
这位 Rao 家的 Neriene 大小姐一脸狐疑地盯着你。"你手里不就有吗？但得先把它放一放，如果我们要一起去跳个舞的话。"

她打了个响指，立马有一个端着托盘的侍者过来准备接过你的饮料。

texts.en: She gives you a skeptical look. "Are you stalling, $playerSirOrMadam? This does not befit your reputation."
texts.zh: 她一脸狐疑地盯着你。"你在拖延时间吗，$playerSirOrMadam？这可与你的名声不符。"

options.en: Put the drink down
Chug the drink and leave the glass
options.zh: 将饮料一饮而尽并交出空杯子

options.en: Um. I'm going to leave now.
My reputation?
Would you care to dance?
What would you like to do?
Um. I'm going to leave now.

texts.en: Her skeptical look takes a turn toward withering.
texts.zh: 她脸上的怀疑被放弃取代了。

options.en: Would you care to dance?
What would you like to do?
Um. I'm going to leave now.

texts.en: She gives you a skeptical look. "Are you feeling well, $playerSirOrMadam?"
texts.zh: 她一脸狐疑地盯着你。"你不舒服吗，$playerSirOrMadam？"

options.en: I was trying to initiate a Transverse Jump.
options.zh: 我刚才正尝试启动横轴跳跃。

options.en: Would you care to dance?
What would you like to do?
Um. I'm going to leave now.

texts.en:
"Oh yes, Granduncle Orcus." She smiles, revisiting some old memory.

"No one can believe he got away with everything he's gotten away with. But if, like him, you've got the dumb luck to walk out of disaster alive again and again - and better yet, you deliver victory in the darkest days of war - they'll let you get away with anything."

She considers a moment, then adds, "Almost anything. It's gone to his head a bit though, I think."
texts.zh:
"哦对，Orcus 伯祖。" 她笑了，重温着往日时光。

"每一次他做了什么出格事情的时候，人们都会认为他这次铁定要被追责了。但如果你运气像他一样好得让人咂舌，能一次又一次地活着走出灾难，甚至还能在战争中最黑暗的日子里带来胜利，他们就不会追究你到底做过什么出格的事情。"

她细想了一下，接着说到："也不能说是一点都不追究吧。依我看，这种待遇已经让他有些上头了。"

options.en: What do you mean by that?
Is your, uh, Granduncle Orcus here?
options.zh: 你的，呃，Orcus 伯祖在这里吗？

texts.en:
"Look at them," she says. "All these fancy people puffing each other up, all smiles and high ideals in public. Once they're behind closed doors, it'll be plotting and backstabbing and spreading rumors."

"I could never stand how two-faced it all is. Grandmother says to take it personally is childish, that it's just how politics is done." She twitches as if to cast off a bit of dirt.
texts.zh:
"看看他们，" 她说。"这些衣冠楚楚的家伙全都在互相吹捧，在人前全都摆出一副团结友善共怀大志的样子。可一旦关起门来，他们就会开始策划阴谋，暗箭伤人，散布谣言。"

"我根本受不了这种一切都是两面派的作风。祖母说过只有傻孩子才会去计较这些，毕竟政治就是这样的。" 她猛地抖了抖身子，仿佛要弄掉身上的脏东西一样。

options.en: Then why are you here?
Does the Admiral Orcus Rao agree with you?
options.zh: Orcus Rao 将军同意你的观点吗？

texts.en:
She catches your eyes for a moment, then looks back toward the crowd. "Because... I thought it might be interesting."

"Anyway, the family has a reputation for a rebellious streak and I'd be remiss not to uphold it."
texts.zh:
她盯着你的眼睛看了一会儿，然后回头看向人群。"因为...我觉得这可能会很有趣。"

"毕竟，我们家族素来以叛逆的作风闻名。我不继承一下反倒显得失职了。"

options.en: House Rao. As in, the owners of this estate.
options.zh: Rao 家族，也就是这庄园的主人。

options.en: House Rao. As in, Admiral Orcus Rao, the Hero of Raesvelg.
options.zh: Rao 家族。也就是那位 Orcus Rao 将军，Raesvelg 的英雄。

options.en: You don't seem too excited about this ball.
options.zh: 你好像对这场舞会不太感兴趣。

texts.en:
"No, captain-auxiliary, you weren't." The cruel spark in Caspian's eye grows. "You don't truly belong here, you see. I was testing you, and you failed because you don't know your place. Not yet."

He licks his lips. This is just the opening salvo.
texts.zh:
"不，'辅助军舰长'，你不能。" Caspian 的眼中闪过无情的光芒，"你并不属于这里。我在测试你，而你没有合格，因为你没有好好掂量过你的地位，至少至今还没有。"

他舔了舔嘴唇。看来刚才那番话还只是个开场白而已。

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
"No, captain-auxiliary, you weren't." The cruel spark in Caspian's eye grows. "Try as you might, you'll never be one of us. You don't belong here. I was testing you, and you failed because you don't know your place. Not yet."

He licks his lips. This is just the opening salvo.
texts.zh:
"不，'辅助军舰长'，你不能。" Caspian 的眼中闪过无情的光芒，"你尽管试，但你永远也不可能融入我们。你不属于这里。我在测试你，而你没有合格，因为你没有好好掂量过你的地位，至少至今还没有。"

他舔了舔嘴唇。看来刚才那番话还只是个开场白而已。

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
A mirthless smile grows on his face, and he turns to nod in acknowledgement to his minions, who cheer the exchange.

"You finally admit you're not one of us." The cruel spark in Caspian's eye grows. "And try as you might, you'll never be one of us. You don't belong here, you see. I was testing you, and you failed by showing your face."

He licks his lips. This is just the opening salvo.
texts.zh:
他的脸上露出了苦笑，转过头去向跟班们点头致意，而后者正在为他本轮 "交锋" 的 "胜利" 欢呼着。

"你终于承认了你不是我们中的一员。" Caspian 的眼中闪过无情的光芒。"你尽管试，但你永远也不可能融入我们。你不属于这里。我在测试你，而你没有合格，因为你真的来了。"

他舔了舔嘴唇。看来刚才那番话还只是个开场白而已。

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
Caspian is caught completely off guard. He sputters, wiping his face.

A small circle of the crowd around you has gone silent. Now they're looking at you.

"That was a big mistake, $playerName," he says, his voice gone cold.
texts.zh:
Caspian 完全没料到这么一出。他擦了擦自己的脸，僵在原地。

你周围的一小圈人沉默了，他们看向了你。

"你犯了个很大的错误，$playerName，" 他说，声音逐渐变得冰冷。

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
Caspian is caught completely off guard as you land a solid blow. He trips on his uniform's scabbard and topples to the ground.

A widening circle of the crowd has gone silent; now they are all looking at you.

He looks up at you looking like a cornered animal, giddy in fear and delight. "You just made such a mistake, $playerName," he says quietly, wiping blood from his nose.
texts.zh:
Caspian 被你的猛击打得措手不及，他被制服中的剑鞘绊了一下，摔倒在地。

你周围越来越多的人沉默了下来，并且全都看向了你。

他抬头看着你，就像一只走投无路的动物，脸上布满了恐惧和喜悦。" 你竟然敢犯这样的错，$playerName。" 他擦了擦鼻子上的血，低声说。

options.en: Continue

texts.en: You hear a familiar and not entirely welcome voice pierce through the murmur of conversation and soft music.
texts.zh: 一个你很熟悉但令人不爽的声音透过周围交谈的低语和轻柔的音乐传了过来。

texts.en:
"Why captain," Caspian Sang oozes up to you, nearly emptied glass in hand. "I would expect a commissioned pirate - my apologies, privateer - to start by plundering our fine hosts' noblesse oblige."

He offers his drink to you, "Please, take mine." You can smell the spirits on his breath. "Do your duty to the Hegemony and fetch me a top-up."

Over Caspian's shoulder you see his gang of minions tittering.
texts.zh:
"怎么了，舰长，" Caspian Sang 慢悠悠地开口了。他手中的杯子已经空空如也。"我还以为一名受雇的海盗，抱歉，应该说是私掠者，会在宴会一开始就会先去糟蹋一轮我们好客主人尽地主之谊给出的慷慨恩赐呢。"

他把他的酒杯递向你，"请拿好我的杯子。" 你能从他的呼吸中闻出满身的酒气，"履行你对 霸主 的职责，给我满上。"

目光越过 Caspian 的肩头，你看到他那群跟屁虫在窃笑。

texts.en:
You merely begin to look the slightest bit thirsty when a human servitor appears as if from an unlikely hyperspace jump.

"$PlayerSirOrMadam." They offer a tray filled with delicate glasses of something effervescent.
texts.zh:
你还没表现出口渴的样子，一个侍者就出现在了你身前，好像是从超空间里跳出来的一样。

"$PlayerSirOrMadam。" 服务员手上端着一个托盘，上面排满了精致的杯子，杯中装着一些冒泡的饮料。

options.en: Take a glass
Wave them away

texts.en:
Your eyes roam over the crowd, focusing on the younger groups of cadets when you hear from behind you that unmistakably insipid laugh. Like a combat targeting lock, your attention spins toward the source.

He's just left his pack of social remorae and is already on an approach vector. Noticing you notice him, he instantly deploys a grin of dubious conviviality.

"$PlayerSirOrMadam." An oblivious human servitor appears beside you offering a tray filled with delicate glasses of something effervescent.
texts.zh:
你的目光掠过人群，聚焦在年轻学员团体的身上。这时你听到身后传来了一阵笑声，还是那么毫无风趣，让人过耳不忘。如同在战斗中锁定目标一般，你将注意力转向了声音的源头。

他离开了他的那群狐朋狗友，正处于向你接近的轨迹上。当发现你已经注意到他时，他立刻咧开嘴，露出一种可疑的愉悦笑容。

"$PlayerSirOrMadam。" 一位服务员出现在了你身边，向你呈上了排满精致酒杯的托盘，杯子里面装着一些冒泡的饮料。

options.en: Take a glass
Wave them away

texts.en:
Your eyes roam over the crowd, observing the push and pull of influence. Figures of vast power move through the space, attracting satellites and disturbing orbits. There, a space marshall of the Hegemony navy; there, the prime executor of Eventide's planetary government.

"$PlayerSirOrMadam." A human servitor appears beside you, offering a tray filled with delicate glasses of something effervescent.
texts.zh:
你的目光在人群中游荡，找寻着各种影响力相互制衡的迹象。犹如在宇宙中肆意驰骋一般，各种权豪势要云集的光景呈现了你眼前，呈众星捧月之态，携移星换斗之势。这边是一位后备舰队的太空元帅，那里则是 Eventide 行星政府的首席执行长。

"$PlayerSirOrMadam。" 一位服务员出现在了你身边，向你呈上了排满精致酒杯的托盘，杯子里面装着一些冒泡的饮料。

options.en: Take a glass
Wave them away

texts.en:
With a quick tap you delete the invitation forever.

You, attending a ball with a bunch of fancy aristocrats? With that insufferable Caspian Sang? No good could come of it.
texts.zh:
你轻触了几下屏幕后永久删掉了邀请函。

你，和一群贵族一起参加舞会？和那个烦人的 Caspian Sang 一起？这样做不会有什么好结果的。

texts.en:
The watching crowd emits a sound of collective sympathetic pain as Cardona falls to the floor with a crack. A tense silence follows.

Sang and his minions look horrified. The onlookers behind them watch, frozen and unsure.
texts.zh:
当 Cardona 重重地倒地时，围观的人群感同身受般地爆出了一阵痛呼。接着是紧张的沉默。

Sang 和他的跟班们看起来吓坏了。他们身后的旁观者呆若木鸡，不敢相信眼前的一切。

texts.en:
You slowly awaken. You feel distinctly unwell; there is no pain, but instead the wrongness of separated flesh.

A portable automedic beeps beside you, cold tubes running into your body. A vaguely Neriene Rao-shaped figure asks you something.
texts.zh:
你缓缓醒来。你感到很不舒服，并不是疼痛，而只有肉体错位的怪异感。

一个便携式自动设备在你身边哔哔作响，冰冷的管子镶入了你的身体中。一个模模糊糊的看起来像 Neriene Rao 的人影在问你一些事情。

options.en: Continue
Continue

texts.en:
Something large and unseen turns on an invisible fulcrum toward a tipping point, a threshold of critical mass igniting a state change.

Someone begins to cheer, then others, with a rising wave of applause and shouts. It is agreed, then, that today we may cheer for the outsider.
texts.zh:
就像是有看不见的巨大物体被隐形撬杆推过了支点一样，周围的气氛仿佛是突破了临界质量一般发生了质变。

先是不知道是谁起头开始了欢呼，之后便有人附和起来，掌声和喝彩如波澜般向外传开。看起来大家达成了共识，今天是一个可以为外人欢呼的日子。

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
You find yourself lifted onto the shoulders of excitable revelers who were not your friend only minutes ago. You are carried bodily back into the grand hall, where pressurized potables are uncapped.

Placed at the head table like a king, you are presented to those gathered as some kind of cult-object, the avatar of victory, honor, or some other notions that will likely make a lot less sense tomorrow when everyone sobers up.
texts.zh:
你发现自己被一群兴奋的欢呼者抬到了他们的肩膀上，而就在几分钟前，他们还不是你的朋友。你不由自主地被抬回了大厅，那里已经满是开了盖的香槟什么的。

你像国王一样被放到了主桌上，被周围的人犹如狂热信徒一般崇拜着。胜利的化身，荣誉的代言，抑或是其他什么理想概念的象征，不管怎么样，等明天大家都酒醒了之后，这些应该就没有什么意义了。

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
The thought crosses your mind that Neriene's sword is no longer in your hand. You hope someone ensured that it was safely stowed. You catch sight of Neriene's face; she is trying to push through the crowd. She looks at once joyful and concerned.

Augusta Rao looks on from afar, her expression aloof.
texts.zh:
你突然想到 Neriene 的剑已经不在你手里了。你默默念叨最好是被人妥善保管了。你看到了 Neriene 的脸，她正试图挤过人群，脸上的神情却是喜忧参半。

Augusta Rao 则只是远远地看着你，神情冷漠。

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
Later - how much later you don't care to consider just yet - you stand unsteadily before your shuttle. The manor staff are efficient; your entourage has been summoned. Some look like they've been woken from sleep, and you note one guard stealthily popping an anti-inebriant. They keep their tone professional, but you can tell that they are glowing with pride. Word of your victory obviously spread quickly through the waiting flight crews.

Neriene appears to see you off from the launch pad. She is well composed despite the excesses of the ball.

"You've made some friends tonight," Neriene says with a hint of a smile, which fades. "And some enemies."
texts.zh:
不久之后，嘛，到底是多久之后你已经不在乎了，你摇摇晃晃地回到了你的穿梭机前。这里的员工效率很高；不需要你的提醒，他们就招来了你的随从。一些人看起来刚刚被叫醒，你还注意到有一个保镖在偷偷地磕了一片醒酒药。他们依旧保持着专业的语气，但你可以看到他们脸上写满了自豪。看起来你胜利的消息已经在等候的船员中传开了。

Neriene 也来为你送行了。尽管在舞会上她玩得很尽兴，现在她却很镇静。

"你今晚结识了一些朋友，" Neriene 说，脸上带着一丝微笑，但笑容渐渐消失了。"但也招惹了一些仇敌。"

options.en: Fun party. See you around, maybe.
options.zh: 很有趣的舞会。之后有缘再见吧。

options.en: And now my enemies know what's waiting for them.
options.zh: 不过那些仇人应该清楚等着他们的是什么了。

options.en: I hope to count you among those friends.
options.zh: 我希望你也被算进那些朋友里。

options.en: I'm never coming to one of these balls ever again.
options.zh: 我真不想再参加这种舞会了。

options.en: I can't believe you convinced me to take part in that debauched bloodsport.
options.zh: 我真不敢相信你居然说服了我，让我去参加那个堕落的血腥游戏。

texts.en: She nods, the hint of a smile returning. "Maybe." She turns away before you can reply, and walks back toward the manor complex.
texts.zh: 她点了点头，脸上又出现了一丝微笑。"也许吧。" 你还没来得及回答，她就转过身去走回了庄园。

options.en: Leave

texts.en: Your shuttle rejoins your $shipOrFleet above $entityName.
texts.zh: 你的穿梭机返回了 $entityName 上方的$shipOrFleet中。

texts.en:
Her brow furrows. "And your friends, I suppose," she says, and turns away.

She starts back toward the manor complex before you can reply.
texts.zh:
她皱了皱眉头。"你的朋友也是，我想。" 她说着转过了身。

你还没能做出回应，她就迈步朝庄园走了回去。

options.en: Leave

texts.en:
"I'd like that," she says, the smile returning.

She looks like she might say more but instead nods and turns away, heading back toward the manor complex before you can reply.
texts.zh:
"我也乐于接受。" 她说，脸上又出现了微笑。

她看起来还想说什么，但取而代之地，她点了点头后转身朝庄园建筑群走了回去 —— 在你能做出答复之前。

options.en: Leave

texts.en:
She nods toward the distant storm clouds, thoughtful, "I can't say I blame you. Perhaps we shall meet again in a more... civilized context."

With that, she turns away and heads toward the manor complex.
texts.zh:
她点了点头，看向远处的风暴云墙，若有所思。"我也不能怪你。也许下次我们能在一个...更文明的环境里碰面。"

说完后，她转身朝庄园建筑群走去。

options.en: Leave

texts.en:
She looks shocked, "You actually think I-" she interrupts herself, holding her palm toward you, her expression hardening.

Neriene opens her mouth to speak, then closes it and quickly turns away, heading back toward the manor complex.
texts.zh:
她看起来很震惊，"你原来认为是我 ——" 她硬生生地刹住了自己的话，向你做出了个 "推开" 的动作，神情僵硬。

Neriene 又张开了嘴想说些什么，但很快沉默了，迅速转身朝庄园建筑群走了回去。

options.en: Leave

texts.en:
You're leaning against a bench, you think, with someone's uniform jacket behind your head. Tall windows glow in the twilight, the blurred forms of revelers moving within.

The mirrors have been allowed to set, leaving the sky glowing darkly in deepest blue.
texts.zh:
你大概是靠在长凳上，你想，有人帮你把制服外套垫在了脑袋后面。高耸的窗户在暮色中闪闪发光，狂欢者模糊的身影在里面摇曳闪动。

恒星镜的傍晚已经落暮，天空中只剩下深蓝色的微光。

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
"Come on, let's get you back to your shuttle."

Neriene pulls you to your feet. Your head spins for a moment, then the automedic whirrs. A sense of fragile wellness fills you.

She gingerly leads you to a discreet servants' access lift and back to your shuttle's pad.
texts.zh:
"来吧，我送你回穿梭机。"

Neriene 把你拉了起来，让你感到一阵头晕眼花。这时自动医疗装置开始嗡嗡作响，把一股脆弱的健康感填入了你的身躯。

她小心翼翼地把你带到了一个不起眼的侍者用电梯里，让你回到了你的穿梭机旁。

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
The manor staff are efficient; your entourage has been summoned. They keep their tone professional, but you can tell that their mood is cautious. Word of your loss obviously spread quickly through the waiting flight crews.

Neriene sees you off from the launch pad.

"Well," she says uncomfortably, "I apologize for... for everything. We're not all clannish brutes."
texts.zh:
这里的员工效率很高。不需要你的提醒，他们就招来了你的随从。他们依旧保持着专业的语气，但你可以看出他们情绪低落。看起来你战败的消息已经在等候的船员中传开了。

穿梭机准备好了，Neriene 在发射台送别你。

"总之，"她很不舒服地说，"我为...这一切向你道歉。我们并不都是排外的畜牲。"

options.en: I won't hold their actions against you.
options.zh: 我不会因为他们的行为指责你。

options.en: Fun party. Glad I survived it.
options.zh: 有趣的派对，很高兴我还挺得过来。

options.en: Now they know I won't back down. I won that much.
options.zh: 现在他们至少知道我不会退缩了，也算是一种小胜吧。

options.en: I enjoyed the dance. We should do it again.
options.zh: 至少我觉得跳舞很有趣，有机会我们该再试试。

options.en: Don't. They just showed me what you really are.
options.zh: 别装了，他们只不过是让我看到了你们的真面目而已。

texts.en:
She nods grimly, accepting your words.

"Until a better time, captain." She turns away before you can reply, heading toward the manor complex.
texts.zh:
她点点头，接受了你的话。

"再择良日吧，舰长。" 你还没来得及回答，她就转身朝庄园走了回去。

options.en: Leave

texts.en: Your shuttle rejoins your $shipOrFleet above $entityName.
texts.zh: 你的穿梭机返回了 $entityName 上方的$shipOrFleet中。

texts.en:
"Me too," she says with the start of a smile.

"Until next time, captain," she says, turning back toward the manor complex before you can reply.
texts.zh:
"我也是，" 她笑了起来。

"再择良日吧，舰长。"你还没来得及回答，她就转身朝庄园走了回去。

options.en: Leave

texts.en:
Her brow furrows. "At the academy we were taught to avoid battle on terms set by the enemy."

She looks like she might say more, but decides against it. With a shake of her head she turns away before you can respond, heading back toward the manor complex.
texts.zh:
她皱了皱眉，"在学院里，我们被教会了别按照敌人设下的规矩来战斗。"

她看起来还想说更多，但放弃了。她点了点头后转身朝庄园建筑群走了回去 —— 在你能做出答复之前。

options.en: Leave

texts.en:
"I'd like that," she says, her smile finally returning.

She looks like she might say more but instead nods quickly and turns away before you can reply, heading back toward the manor complex.
texts.zh:
"我也这么想，" 她说，脸上笑容重现。

她看起来还想说什么，但取而代之地，她点了点头后转身朝庄园建筑群走了回去 —— 在你能做出答复之前。

options.en: Leave

texts.en: She looks hurt, opens her mouth to speak, then closes it and quickly turns away, heading toward the manor complex.
texts.zh: 她看起来受到了不小的打击，张开嘴想说些什么，但很快一言不发地闭上嘴，转身朝庄园建筑群走了回去。

options.en: Leave

texts.en: You think to yourself that this isn't the time to bring up your experience at the Rao compound on Eventide.
texts.zh: 你心想，现在不是提起你在 Eventide 上 Rao 家庄园里的经历的时候。

texts.en:
"Nonetheless, if you insist, then I shall be forced to concede," Bornanew says.

"If we... if you can execute a raid; if you can do it without implicating the Church; if seizing this fake relic quickly and quietly will lead us to its maker and thereafter to a swift conclusion of the whole matter... then maybe the Church can avoid schism and disaster."

"If, and only if, it is necessary," he concludes.
texts.zh:
"尽管如此，如果你坚持，那么我也不得不让步，" Bornanew 说。

"如果我们...如果你能发动一次劫掠；如果你能在不牵连教会的情况下做到；如果迅速而神不知鬼不觉地夺取这个假圣物能引导我们找到它的制造者，从而迅速结束整件事...那么也许教会就能避免分裂和灾难。"

"如果，而且仅如果，这是必要的，" 他总结道。

options.en: It is necessary. I shall make the arrangements.
options.zh: 这是必要的。我会安排好。

options.en: Let's discuss other options before deciding.
options.zh: 在决定之前，我们先讨论一下其他方案。

texts.en:
Bornanew bows his head to your words. His expression is grim.

Menes has not been discreet. As a celebration of his first cycle as the new demarchon of Olinadu, he invited a holodoc team for a puff-piece interview and viewing of his 'collection'. Your tactical team reviews the holos, constructing schematic of the interior of Menes' complex, inferring layout and defenses from this and other publicly available information.
texts.zh:
听到你的话，Bornanew 低下了头，表情严峻。

Menes 并没有谨慎行事。为了庆祝他担任 Olinadu 新统领满一个星历年，他邀请一个全息纪录片团队进行了宣传性的采访，并展示了他的 '藏品'。你的战术团队检视了这些全息影像，构建了 Menes 庄园内部的示意图，并根据这些和其他公开信息推断出布局和防御。

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
It is estimated that roughly 100 marines will be required to pull off the operation.

Your marines will be equipped with an eclectic mix of equipment to allow them to pose as high-level pirates. They will be secretly infiltrated into Olinadu as, variously, spacer crew on shore-leave, contract technicians, and ne'er-do-wells looking to spend ill-gotten gains somewhere away from heavy law enforcement.

It goes without saying that you shall need to approach Olinadu with your $shipOrFleet's transponder off. Menes' overly charitable outlook on your character and generalized inattention to his official duties should allow you to join his 'party' with little oversight about how you actually got there.
texts.zh:
据估计，大约需要{100 名陆战队员}才能完成这次任务。

你的陆战队员将配备乱七八糟的装备来冒充高级海盗。他们将以各种身份秘密渗透到 Olinadu 上，比如上岸休假的太空船员、合同制技术员，以及想在远离严密执法的地方挥霍不义之财的无赖。

不用说，你需要在$shipOrFleet{应答器关闭}的情况下接近 Olinadu。Menes 对你身份的过分慷慨和他对公务的普遍疏忽，应该能让你几乎不受监督地加入他的 '派对'，并且不会让人在意你是怎么去到那里的。

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
To avert suspicion and ensure optimal timing, you and Bornanew will personally attend Menes' party when the raid is executed.

The raid will commence when two of a series of randomly generated time-slots are passed without receiving a stand-down signal. This signal will be, by all appearances, a routine status query to your $shipOrFleet, and appear to be perfectly routine behaviour for a justifiably neurotic independent $shipOrFleet operator.

Bornanew is watchful throughout the planning process, only occasionally advocating for lower-force protocols when a particularly bloodthirsty marine squad leader expresses more enthusiasm than strictly required for certain tactical details.
texts.zh:
为了避免怀疑并掌握最佳时机，你和 Bornanew 将在劫掠进行时亲自参加 Menes 的派对。

在一系列随机生成的时段中，如果中止信号连续两个时段未被发出，那么劫掠行动就将会启动。无论从何种角度看，这个中止信号都只是你对自己$shipOrFleet的例行状态查询，对于一个有理由时刻保持警惕的独立$shipOrFleet指挥官来说，这种行为再正常不过了。

Bornanew 在整个制定计划的过程中都保持慎言，只是偶尔在某个特别嗜血的陆战队长对一些战术细节展现出超出必要限度的热情时，他才主张采用较低强度的方案。

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
Later, in the briefing room, you find Bornanew standing over a detailed schematic of Menes' complex. It rotates slowly in the shared display volume, gradually shadowing and illuminating his face.

It takes a moment, but you see that his eyes are closed and his lips are moving.

A prayer, you suspect.
texts.zh:
之后，在简报室里，你发现 Bornanew 站在 Menes 庄园的详细结构图前。结构图在共享显示屏中缓缓旋转，交错的光影让他的脸庞明暗不定。

过了一会儿你才发现，他的双眼紧闭，嘴唇微动。

你猜，那是在祷告。

texts.en:
Bornanew nods, putting his hand back on his book as if drawing knowledge from it.
OR
"Of course, captain," Bornanew says.
OR
Bornanew looks down at his notebook and turns a page, then turns it back. "Of course, yes."
texts.zh:
Bornanew 点点头，把手放回他的书上，好像在从中汲取知识。
OR
"当然，舰长，" Bornanew说。
OR
Bornanew 低头看着他的笔记本，翻了一页，然后又翻了回来。"好，当然。"

options.en: We should steal the glove.
options.zh: 我们应该偷走那个手套。

options.en: Let's discuss the heist option again.
options.zh: 我们再讨论一下抢劫的方案吧。

options.en: I'll pretend to be a collector looking to buy a unique item.
options.zh: 我会假装成想购买独特物品的收藏家。

options.en: I could pretend to have a relic to sell. Any ideas?
options.zh: 我可以假装有件圣物要卖。有什么主意吗？

options.en: Let's discuss me posing as a buyer again.
options.zh: 我们再讨论一下我扮成买家的事情吧。

options.en: I should invite Horus Yaribay to this 'gathering'.
options.zh: 我应该邀请 Horus Yaribay 参加这个 '聚会'。

options.en: Let's discuss inviting Horus Yaribay to this party.
options.zh: 我们讨论一下邀请 Horus Yaribay 参加这个派对的事吧。

options.en: I'll simply send my marines in to seize the relic.
options.zh: 我会直接派遣陆战队员夺取圣物。

options.en: Let's discuss the raid option again.
options.zh: 我们再讨论一下劫掠的方案吧。

texts.en:
You can tell he doesn't like the idea.

"That seems... it would be a blunt approach," he says. "And risky."
texts.zh:
你能看出来他不喜欢这个主意。

"那听上去...是种粗暴的做法，" 他说。"而且有风险。"

texts.en:
Your tactical officer has already spearheaded an effort to discreetly collect what public information is available on Menes Yaribay's compound. Sensors has arranged passive scans to correlate with on-record plans of the structure. Comms found a PR puff-piece holo in which Menes gives a personal tour of part of his 'collection'.

All you really need to do is get yourself invited into the inner sanctum.
texts.zh:
你的战术军官已经带头谨慎地收集了关于 Menes Yaribay 庄园的公开信息。传感器技官进行了被动扫描，来与记录在案的建筑平面图进行核对。通讯军官则找到了一份公关宣传全息影像，其中 Menes 亲自带领参观了他的部分 '收藏品'。

你所需要做的，就是让自己被邀请进入那个内部密室。

texts.en:
A holo of the complex spins in ghostly form in the shared visual workspace.

Your tools are multitude. All you really need to do is get yourself invited into the inner sanctum.
texts.zh:
庄园的全息影像在共享视觉工作区中如幽灵般旋转着。

你有很多工具。你所需要做的就是让自己被邀请进入那个内部密室。

options.en: I often find the direct approach the most effective.
options.zh: 我发现直截了当的方法常常最有效。

options.en: Don't tell me you've never stolen before, $global.jethroName.
options.zh: 别告诉我你从没偷过东西，$global.jethroName。

options.en: I've got the tools and the intel. I'll steal that glove.
options.zh: 我手头上有工具和情报。让我来偷走那个手套。

options.en: Let's discuss other options.
options.zh: 我们讨论一下其他方案吧。

options.en: It's decided. I'll steal that glove.
options.zh: 就这么定了。我来偷走那个手套。

options.en: Let's discuss other options.
options.zh: 我们讨论一下其他方案吧。

texts.en:
He looks at you, and you see that he knows he has no argument for you.

Bornanew sighs. "Nonetheless, theft is a sin. And I did swear a sacred oath that I would never steal again."
texts.zh:
他看着你，你知道他无法反驳。

Bornanew 叹了口气。"尽管如此，盗窃是罪。而且我曾发过神圣的誓，我再也不会行窃了。"

options.en: Then I'll steal it. You can just show up and be yourself.
options.zh: 那我来偷。你只需要露面，当好你自己就行了。

texts.en: "But I, I-" he stutters to a halt. "I suppose, in the strictest sense this is... captain, I do not like it. Is there no alternative?"
texts.zh: "但我，我 ——" 他结结巴巴，有点说不下去了。"我觉得，从最严格的意义上说，这...舰长，我不喜欢这样。没有别的选择了吗？"

options.en: No one gets hurt. And it's a fake which they stole from your people in the first place.
options.zh: 没人会受伤。而且那是个赝品，是他们先从你们那里偷来的。

options.en: I could send a marine raid in to steal it so we don't have to.
options.zh: 我可以发动陆战队劫掠来把它弄到手，这样我们就没必要自己上了。

options.en: I could threaten to bombard the planet until Menes surrenders the relic.
options.zh: 我可以威胁要轰炸这颗星球，直到 Menes 交出遗物。

options.en: Fine. Let's think of something else.
options.zh: 好吧。我们想点别的办法。

texts.en: Bornanew nods, still looking displeased.
texts.zh: Bornanew 点点头，看起来仍然不太高兴。

texts.en:
Your tactical officer has already spearheaded an effort to discreetly collect what public information is available on Menes Yaribay's compound. Sensors has arranged passive scans to correlate with on-record plans of the structure. Comms found a PR puff-piece holo in which Menes gives a personal tour of part of his 'collection'.

All you really need to do is get yourself invited into the inner sanctum.
texts.zh:
你的战术军官已经带头谨慎地收集了关于 Menes Yaribay 庄园的公开信息。传感器技官进行了被动扫描，来与记录在案的建筑平面图进行核对。通讯军官则找到了一份公关宣传全息影像，其中 Menes 亲自带领参观了他的部分 '收藏品'。

你所需要做的，就是让自己被邀请进入那个内部密室。

options.en: Then it's decided. I'll have tools, it'll be fine.
options.zh: 那就这么定了。我会带上工具，没问题的。

options.en: Let's discuss other options before deciding.
options.zh: 在决定之前，我们先讨论一下其他方案。

texts.en:
Sometimes acquiring something is as simple as taking it.

Both you and Bornanew - who is unenthusiastic, but professional throughout - are outfitted with an inconspicuous set of tools: a sheet-diamond rated cutter, EM glitcher, lockbreakers.

Bornanew sets aside some of the bulkier accoutrement with a shake of his head.
texts.zh:
有时候，想获取某个东西，就和直接把它拿走一样简单。

你和 Bornanew —— 他虽然不情愿，但全程都很专业 —— 都配备了一套不显眼的工具：一张金刚石切割薄片、电磁干扰器、开锁器。

Bornanew 摇了摇头，把一些比较笨重的装备放在一边。

options.en: Continue

texts.en:
Your tech officer installs a schematic of Menes' complex and a suite of scramblers on your datapad, a remote interfacer is hidden inside a fashionable stylus.

You perform the operation of various gadgets with your armorer, and review the choreography of the heist with your tactical officer. It is not a perfect plan, but with a combination of initiative, redundancy, and exceptional access...

Bornanew is standing very still, his fist against his jaw.
texts.zh:
你的技术军官在你的数据平板上载入了 Menes 庄园的示意图和一套干扰器，远程接口隐藏在一支很潮的触控笔里。

你和你的军械员一起操作各种装置，并和你的战术军官一起复核了这次抢劫的流程。这并非天衣无缝的计划，但凭借主动出击、多重保障以及绝佳的渠道...

Bornanew 一动不动地站着，拳头抵着下巴。

options.en: Yes? What is it?

texts.en:
"It won't work," he says.

"With all due respect, your tactician is no thief. And neither are you. It must be me."
texts.zh:
"这行不通，" 他说。

"恕我直言，你的战术军官不是小偷。你也不是。得让我来。"

options.en: Aren't you opposed to theft? You swore an oath.
options.zh: 你不是反对偷窃吗？你发过誓的。

options.en: It's a pretty good plan. And I have the tools.
options.zh: 这是个相当不错的计划。而且我有工具。

options.en: I, too, have my faith. Is that nothing?
options.zh: 我也有我的信仰。那难道不算什么吗？

options.en: Tell me what your plan is.
options.zh: 告诉我你的计划是什么。

options.en: You're not going to let this go, are you.
options.zh: 你不会就这么算了的，是吧。

options.en: If you insist, then.
options.zh: 如果你坚持的话，那行吧。

texts.en: "I am. I did," he says. "But more necessary than my conscience is our success. I shall bear my burden."
texts.zh: "是。我发过誓，" 他说道，"但比我的良心更重要的是我们的成功。我将承下这份重担。"

texts.en:
"Why should Menes leave you alone with the relic, or at all?" He looks over at you.

"I am a Knight of Ludd, devoted and taciturn. I shall simply... display the power of my faith."
texts.zh:
"为什么 Menes 会让你单独和圣物待在一起，或者让你单独留下？" 他看着你。

"我是个卢德骑士，虔诚而沉默寡言。我只需要...展现我信仰的力量。"

texts.en:
"Pray forgive me, captain; I do no question your faith." He presses his hands together.

"But Menes Yaribay cannot see into your soul. He will see your uniform, and my robes. That will be enough."
texts.zh:
"请原谅我，舰长；我没有质疑你的信仰。" 他双手合十。

"但是 Menes Yaribay 看不透你的灵魂。他只会看到你的制服和我的教袍。那就足够了。"

texts.en:
"We attend Menes' party. Be interesting. Be yourself. Get Menes to show off the glove."

"I know this trade, captain. Have faith." He pauses for a moment, acknowledging some irony in his own words. "It works best if you act natural."
texts.zh:
"我们直接参加 Menes 的派对，表现得有趣些。做好你自己，让 Menes 炫耀那个手套。"

"我懂该怎么做这笔买卖，舰长，要有信心。" 他顿了一下，承认了自己话中的某种讽刺意味，"如果你能表现得自然些，效果就最好。"

texts.en: He crosses his arms. "I am not."
texts.zh: 他双手抱胸。"我不会。"

texts.en: Bornanew gives you a distraught look.
texts.zh: Bornanew 露出了心烦意乱的表情。

texts.en:
Bornanew gives you a distraught look.

"I pray that is merely a joke in poor taste."
texts.zh:
Bornanew 露出了心烦意乱的表情。

"我祈祷这只是个品味低劣的玩笑。"

texts.en: Bornanew nods, still looking a bit as though he's eaten something foul.
texts.zh: Bornanew 点点头，看起来还是像吃了什么难吃的东西。

texts.en:
"Yes, I- That's not-"

He exhales sharply. "Not only is theft a sin. I did also swear a sacred oath that I would never steal again."
texts.zh:
"是的，我 —— 那不是 ——"

他猛地呼出一口气。"不仅盗窃是罪。我还曾发过神圣的誓，我再也不会行窃了。"

options.en: Then I'll steal it. You can just show up and be yourself.
options.zh: 那我来偷。你只需要露面，当好你自己就行了。

texts.en:
"Well. Menes likes you," he says. "He likes people who are rich and exciting, and important. He wants you to like him. He wants to be associated with people who are like what he imagines you are."

"Offering to buy his 'relic'... he would like that, I think."
texts.zh:
"好的。Menes 喜欢你，" 他说。"他喜欢有钱、经历刺激、身份重要的人。他也希望你喜欢他。他希望能和他想象中的你这样的人搞好关系。"

"你提出要买他的 '圣物'...他会喜欢的，我觉得。"

texts.en: "If you have the credits," Bornanew says, "Or if you can leverage existing assets and status, perhaps you can simply buy the glove from Menes."
texts.zh: "如果你星币够多，" Bornanew 说，"或者如果你能利用现有的资产和地位，也许你可以直接从 Menes 那里买下手套。"

options.en: It could be expensive, however.

texts.en: "It could be," he says. "And before you ask, the Church will not approve additional funding. The Reverend Archcurate herself has spent her covert budget too freely on my case already."
texts.zh: "可能会，" 他说。"而且我得提前说明一下，教会是不会批准额外拨款的。宗师大人已经在我的事情上太过随便地花费了她的秘密预算。"

options.en: Are you... proposing that I cheat Menes Yaribay?
options.zh: 你是在...建议我哄骗 Menes Yaribay 吗？

options.en: If the Church isn't paying... you're asking me to pay.
options.zh: 如果教会不付钱...你是要我付钱。

options.en: I am not exactly overflowing with credits at the moment.
options.zh: 我现在手头并不是特别宽裕。

options.en: I may be rich, but you intend to destroy the glove, right?
options.zh: 我也许有钱，但你是打算毁掉那个手套的，对吧？

options.en: It sounds like we should just steal the glove.
options.zh: 听起来我们应该直接偷走那个手套。

options.en: I may not have credits, but I do operate an independent colony...
options.zh: 我也许没那么多星币，但我确实运营着一个独立的殖民地...

options.en: I may not have credits, but I am a member of the Persean League...
options.zh: 我也许没那么多星币，但我是 英仙座联盟 的成员...

options.en: I do happen to know someone extremely rich. Rayan Arroyo.
options.zh: 我碰巧认识一个极其有钱的人。Rayan Arroyo。

options.en: Let's do it. I'll pretend that I want to buy a 'genuine' relic.
options.zh: 就这么办。我会假装我想买一件 '真正的' 圣物。

options.en: Let's discuss other options first.
options.zh: 我们先讨论一下其他方案吧。

texts.en:
"I'm, uh..." Bornanew turns red.

"I... in the due course of investigation... if - no, not if - when we prove that the glove is a fake we demonstrate that the deal was made on invalid terms. But we need the glove first for physical evidence. It's... yes, it does involve a conscious deception... please don't look at me like that, captain," he says, almost indignant.

"It doesn't involve any killing, at least. I do pray it won't come to that."
texts.zh:
"我，呃..." Bornanew 脸一红。

"我...在调查的过程中...如果 —— 不，不是如果 —— 等我们证明手套是假的，也就同时证明了这笔交易的基本条款无效。但我们首先需要手套作为物证。这...对，这确实是一种刻意的欺骗...请别用那种眼神看我，舰长，" 他说着，语气似乎带着愤慨。

"至少这不涉及杀戮。我曾真诚祈祷过事情不发展到那一步。"

options.en: I'm just surprised. It's a good idea, $global.jethroName.
options.zh: 我只是很惊讶。这是个好主意，$global.jethroName。

options.en: I too.
I too. (lie)

texts.en: He sighs. "I beg you spare me praise in this particular instance."
texts.zh: 他叹了口气。"我求你别在这种特殊情况下夸我。"

texts.en: He presses his hands together and nods.
texts.zh: 他双手合十，点了点头。

texts.en: He presses his hands together, though gives you a brief, suspicious look.
texts.zh: 他双手合十，但向你投来了短暂的怀疑眼神。

texts.en:
You can see the inner conflict on Bornanew's face.

He knows he is asking far, far too much. But he wants to. If he had the credits, he would give them to the cause of the Church without a second thought. But he is a Knight of Ludd, sworn to poverty but for the allowance granted to him by his order - or by the indulgence of the Reverend Archcurate Jaspis.

He sees that you see all of this. And, knowing that words can only do harm, he makes the barest movement toward a shrug. A way of saying, you know who I am; what I am; what I need ask. Your choice is yours.
texts.zh:
你可以从 Bornanew 的脸上看出他内心的挣扎。

他知道他要求得实在太多了，但他需要这些。如果他有星币，他会毫不犹豫地把它们贡献给教会的事业。但他是一名卢德骑士，发誓安贫乐道，除了因被指派任务而领到的资金，以及因大祭司 Jaspis 的宽容而得到的津贴外，他一无所有。

他清楚你对这些事情十分了解。而且，他知道言语只会造成伤害，于是只轻微地耸了耸肩。意思是，你知道我是谁；我是什么；我需要什么。选择权在你的手上。

texts.en:
"That is a problem," Bornanew admits.

"I don't believe Menes will take an offer seriously unless you demonstrate that you possess immense wealth. A half million credits, at least. To be safe." He taps his book, "Though if you could talk him into accepting payment in the form of installments, you'd only have to pay a fraction of the full price to take possession of the glove..."
texts.zh:
"这是个问题，" Bornanew 承认道。

"除非你能证明你拥有巨额财产，否则我不觉得 Menes 会认真对待报价。保险起见，至少得有五十万星币。" 他敲了敲他的书，"不过如果你能说服他接受分期付款，你可能只需要支付全价的一小部分就能拿到手套..."

texts.en:
"Yes," Bornanew admits.

"I don't believe Menes will take an offer seriously unless you can demonstrate that you possess immense wealth. A half million credits, at least. To be safe." He taps his book, "Though if you could talk him into accepting payment in the form of installments, you might only have to pay a fraction of the full price to take possession..."
texts.zh:
"是的，" Bornanew 承认道。

"除非你能证明你拥有巨额财产，否则我不觉得 Menes 会认真对待报价。保险起见，至少得有五十万星币。" 他敲了敲他的书，"不过，如果你能说服他接受分期付款，你可能只需要支付全价的一小部分就能拿到..."

texts.en: "That's true," Bornanew says. "You might be able to talk Menes into accepting payment in the form of smaller installments. Then if we can resolve the entire matter of the glove quickly, perhaps you would only have to pay the initial deposit..."
texts.zh: "那确实，" Bornanew 说。"你或许能说服 Menes 接受分期付款。那么如果我们能迅速完全解决手套的问题，也许你就只需要支付首期定金..."

texts.en:
"An excellent point," Bornanew says, looking hopeful.

"This gives you exceptional credibility with Menes -- after all, you're a fellow demarch! I would wonder if you couldn't defer payment entirely, or convince him to accept a small percentage as a deposit to be paid later. And then if we resolve the matter of the glove quickly..."
texts.zh:
"这是个很好的切入点，" Bornanew 说，看起来颇有信心。

"这让你在 Menes 面前有了极大的信誉 —— 毕竟，你是一位民选统领！我甚至在想你是不是可以完全推迟付款，或者说服他先接受一小部分作为稍后支付的定金。然后如果我们能迅速解决手套的问题..."

texts.en: Bornanew looks up. "Do you think he would assist us in this matter?"
texts.zh: Bornanew 抬起头。"你觉得他会在这件事上帮我们吗？"

options.en: Not likely.
Absolutely not.
No.
He'd hate everything about this scheme.
options.zh: 他会讨厌关于这个计划的一切。

texts.en: "I see," he says. "Perhaps we should consider a different option."
texts.zh: "我明白了，" 他说道，"也许我们应该考虑其它方案。"
